business_process: Client communications, secure document exchange, and incident notices
description: Email and calls with clients; Client A portal and gateway sessions; Client B instrumentation platform; the 24-hour incident notices Client A and Client B require; telling a client at once about a condition seen in the field
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 24-hour notice duties in CSCA-A (7) and GRS-B (3); a client must hear at once about a condition that may affect dam safety so it can report under 18 CFR 12.10; clients expect a reply within one business day
manual_workaround: Phone calls and texts from the phone; clients send documents only through their own portals, which can be reached from the tablet; printed client contact sheet
dependent_third_parties: Email and file suite provider; Client A portal and gateway; Client B platform vendor; phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-engineer (single point of failure); home office

description: Physical field inspections of dams, spillways, galleries, and gate structures; field notes, photos, and inspection checklists on the tablet and phone; the Client A Part 12D field inspection 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-18
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Field dates are fixed weeks ahead with client staff, divers, or rope-access crews; a slip of more than 3 days pushes the work to the next available window; tablet syncs field records each night
manual_workaround: Paper inspection forms and a field notebook; printed drawings issued by the client for field use only and returned at the end of the visit; phone camera as a spare
dependent_third_parties: Client site staff; field assistant; phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-engineer (single point of failure; the approved independent consultant for Client A); field assistant; vehicle

description: Review of prior reports and analyses of record; seepage, stability, and hydraulic checks; instrumentation trend review; drafting reports; sealing each report with the owner's digital signing certificate
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client A must file its Part 12D report on time and the report must be signed and sealed by the independent consultant (18 CFR 12.36(h)); about $720 of billable work per working day; RPO of 24 hours is met for synced project folders but not for model files or the CEII archive (monthly USB backup only)
manual_workaround: Reinstall the analysis software on a replacement laptop from the vendors' download portals; work from synced project folders; ask the client to re-send source documents through its portal
dependent_third_parties: Engineering software vendors (licenses); email and file suite provider; FERC CEII Coordinator (for re-requests)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-engineer (single point of failure; only licensed engineer and holder of the signing certificate)

description: Monthly invoices to clients; bank feed; expense records; year-end work with the tax accountant
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $3,500 billed per week; clients pay in 30 days; savings cover about two months of expenses
manual_workaround: Invoice from a word-processing template and record payments by hand; the bank's own portal
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS provider; bank; tax accountant

description: Professional engineer license, insurance, client agreements, the CEII non-disclosure agreement and Client A authorization, the client information register, and security records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadlines are measured in weeks (license renewal, insurance, CEII verification ends 2026-12-31); records change rarely
manual_workaround: Paper originals of key agreements in the locked cabinet; agencies and clients can resend copies
dependent_third_parties: Email and file suite provider; FERC CEII Coordinator; insurer
